scope: 32 original N4 mixed-context tasks, 24 conservatively shared context keys, eight domains, nine existing sets; no new group, chapter or gate.
primaryEvidence: Reuse the exact N4 construction/operation decisions in the named source records; reopened passages support the same senses. Optional advanced synonyms do not become required contrasts.

inspectedPassages.use: Possibility; do not import blanket case-marker or colloquial-incorrectness claims.
Purposefully arranged resulting state; not a universal が/を preparation-duration rule.
Made-to-act subject as lexical actor; に causer; no necessary anger/physical force.
Uncertain plain proposition, including tense/polarity inside the proposition.
Prospective participation premise and an earlier preparation response; no universal exclusive-family or reversed-time rule is adopted.
Maintained positive/negative effort; no imported N3 habitual-plan/self-belief contrast.
Causer versus caused actor, including an を-marked intransitive actor. Do not adopt a に=let/を=make shortcut.
Speaker expectation, not advice or guaranteed fact.
Outer rejection versus negative inner proposition. Reject the page's contradictory 'not the only possibility' and inverted probability claims; use the qualified existing judgment ledger.
Personal intention; no required booking and no N3 assumed-role contrast.
Planned event despite a contingency. Do not adopt its inverted modifier/modifiee explanation or require a reservation.
Arrival as trigger. Ongoing ていたら is supported by the existing conditional sources; do not extend underlying-action completion to every usage.
Negative state conditional; not a blanket ban on following requests.
Concessive attachment and counterexpectation, including quoted speech. Distinct from the purpose/resource /のに page. Do not conflate them or copy its stereotypes/dialect judgments.

secondarySourceAccess.result: Attempt returned a CAPTCHA page; not claimed as inspected. Existing source records retain their earlier secondary/dictionary evidence.

placement.reason: The owners already cover each scored operation. Labels, readings and finite forms are supplied; no unsupplied morphology is newly required.
placement.boundedDomains: Passive perspective is causative-passive role interpretation, not new standalone-passive breadth. Temporal transfer uses prospective preparation, arrival triggers and ongoing encounters. Habit transfer uses maintained practice, not every change/habit family.

groupLabelAmendment.old: のに, わりに and くせに: suitable alternatives and stance
groupLabelAmendment.reason: Observed facet validation rejects mixed target classes. Preserve the original answer classes and rename only this question-visible label to remove the answer cue; no learner/SRS identity or gate changes.

topicLeakAudit.finding: Question-side topic/focus notices name the approved group, not the answer facet. The overlap group names concessive forms and would leak a simple concessive-versus-reason task.
topicLeakAudit.mitigation: Neutralize only the overlap group's label. Keep the original contrast-or-reason relationship and each facet's sole concessive-contrast target; no new classes or facets. The unchanged combinations group already explicitly includes outcomes and reasons. Question/focus metadata does not expose the chosen facet.

criticalFacet.note: The two new complaints share ONE key. The two old N3 members stay N3. This repairs this facet only, not every historical coverage gap.

contextAccounting: Each domain has four tasks but only three new scene keys. Paired viewpoints, item stages, timetable judgments, excursion phases, routines and complaints are counted once.
typingContract: Fixed labels accept the printed spelling and explicitly supplied reading only; finite fragments accept the printed form or its all-hiragana rendering. No claim of unrestricted paraphrase grading.
provenance: All Japanese/English exercise texts are original. Sources are construction/sense evidence, not copied practice questions.

independentReview.reconciliation: The original reviewer verified all five changed task objects, ten rendered branches, ten accepted completions and their complete lexical records. Both deficient contexts were substantively replaced; no new regression or remaining actionable finding was established.
